Privacy, in plain words

Short version: the tool runs on your device, and what you paste stays on your device.

Your reviews stay on your device

The generator runs in your browser. Reviews you paste are not sent or stored.

Registration

Registration is collected through our Google Form — it asks for your first name, last name, phone, email, and restaurant address — and kept in the FiveStarsBoost registration list. Tapping “I've registered” on this page only unlocks the tool during your visit; this page itself doesn't store what you entered in the form.

We never sell personal data

We don't sell personal data. Paid plans are sold through Gumroad and Etsy, which handle payment.
